why: Two roots that fell together: ло́жка is from the лог- of a hollow, ложь from лг-. A -ка ending is not a signal.
The -ка is part of the borrowed word, not an ending on the month. A vest has nothing to do with May.
A deverbal noun from пое́здить, not a small по́езд — you can make a пое́здка on foot.
Different words: the folder is from German Pappe, cardboard. The animacy already says so — a little person is still a person.
Unrelated: ча́йка is named for the bird's cry. A little tea would not be animate either.
